verdict.rationale: Snowflake documents Semantic Views, a schema-level database object for declaring business metrics, entities and their relationships once. Cortex Analyst answers natural-language questions and can be served to AI agents through the managed MCP server, so the core story is delivered. missing for 10: explicit documentation that Cortex Analyst and SQL queries resolve against Semantic Views consistently, explicit coverage of dimensions and join definitions beyond 'relationships', governance specifics for semantic objects, independent or hands-on corroboration.
